purpose: Shared oracle for the near-dup gate. services/api/internal/modelderive/neardup.go is the implementation of record; bench/derive/benchlib.py is a Python port used to align comparison packs. Both assert this file, so a change to either side that moves a score or flips a policy hit fails loudly instead of silently aligning packs under a policy production no longer runs. Regenerating expectations to make a test pass is a recalibration, and recalibration is an operator ruling.

normalize.name: superscript-two-is-not-a-digit
normalize.note: Go unicode.IsDigit is Nd-only, so U+00B2 (category No) collapses to a space. Python str.isdigit() returns true for it — a naive port keeps it and changes every trigram.

normalize.name: roman-numeral-is-not-a-letter
normalize.note: Go unicode.IsLetter is L*-only, so U+2167 (category Nl) collapses to a space. Python str.isalpha() returns true for it.

normalize.name: dotted-capital-i-simple-lowercase
normalize.note: U+0130 is the only unconditional lowercase EXPANSION in SpecialCasing.txt: Python's full str.lower() yields 'i' + U+0307, Go's simple per-rune ToLower yields plain 'i'. Left unhandled, the combining mark categorizes as a non-letter and becomes a space, shifting every trigram after it.

normalize.name: final-sigma-context-rule-must-not-apply
normalize.note: Python's whole-string lower() applies the Final_Sigma context rule and yields 'ς' word-finally; Go's per-rune ToLower always maps U+03A3 to U+03C3. The port lowercases per character precisely to deny the rule its context.
